n_b_input = input().split()
n = int(n_b_input[0])
b = int(n_b_input[1])
arr_input = list(map(int, input().split()))

arr = [0] + arr_input  # 1-based indexing
oddCount = [0] * (n + 1)
evenCount = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 1:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1]
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1

cutCount = 0
diffArr = []

for i in range(2, n, 2):
    if oddCount[i] == evenCount[i]:
        diffArr.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))
    else:
        diffArr.append(-1)

diffArr.sort()
sum_val = 0
for val in diffArr:
    if val != -1 and sum_val + val <= b:
        cutCount += 1
        sum_val += val

print(cutCount)
</translated_code>
